about: Every place a client may answer a shared case otherwise than its file states, and why
(internal/clientcases). says: the verdict the client gives instead, or not_checked when it
gives none. basis: language (the language forces it), design (the code documents it as
intended) or open (nobody has decided; it is a finding too). The judge fails a difference
the client no longer shows, so this list cannot outlive what it explains.

cases: golden/requests/module request with an approved rule
published/v0.27.1/requests/module request with an approved rule
differences.why: the TypeScript client sends no module runs (a module run is the docker provider's compiled simulator, which only the Go and Python clients call), so it digests no module request or result; clients/typescript/test/record.test.ts skips them
